# Parley

> Parley is a competitive matchmaking, tournament, and stats-tracking platform built for Discord communities — with first-class support for Rainbow Six Siege (R6) and Brawl Stars. The platform links Discord identities to in-game accounts, ingests ranked-season performance telemetry, and uses a Composite Performance Rating (CPR) plus Glicko-2 team balancing to assemble fair 5v5 lobbies, run ranked queues, and operate single-elimination brackets. Live global leaderboards are streamed in real time from a Cloudflare Workers backend.

## Landing

- [Parley — Competitive Matchmaking and Tournaments for Discord](https://parley.bot/): The home of Parley — R6 Discord bot, R6 Discord matchmaking, R6 Discord tournament hosting, and live global R6 leaderboards for Siege players and Discord communities.
- [Live Global Leaderboard](https://parley.bot/leaderboard): Real-time R6 leaderboard, Rainbow Six Siege player rankings, and Discord community standings for Rainbow Six Siege competitive play.

## Key Features

- R6 Discord bot: account linking, ranked queue, custom lobbies, tournament brackets, and stats lookup inside Discord.
- R6 Discord matchmaking: telemetry-driven balanced 5v5 lobbies using CPR and Glicko-2 for Rainbow Six Siege competitive play.
- R6 Discord tournament: single-elimination brackets, registration, seed tracking, and result reporting for Discord gaming communities.
- Live R6 leaderboard: guild-scoped and global Rainbow Six Siege player rankings, refreshed in real time over WebSocket.
- Stats tracker for R6: K/D, win rate, KPR, KOST, headshot percentage, and survival rate, normalized across the current ranked season.
- Discord tournament platform: scoped per Discord server with guild-specific matchmaking rules, rank gates, and quotas.
- R6 ranked bot: 5-stack, 10-man, pugs, and scrim support for Rainbow Six Siege Discord communities.
- Team balancer: automatic two-sided lobby balancing that minimizes expected skill gap using Glicko-2 ratings.
- Brawl Stars Discord bot: account linking, stats, and competitive tooling for Brawl Stars Discord servers.
